title: A Simple 4 Part Test to Know If You’ve Hired the Right VP
content:
Did you hire a good enough VP? 4 part test: – who great did they hire in the first 60 days?– did their #1 key metric improve?– did they take part of the job off your plate?– does the team believe? If they don't pass the 4 part test, they aren't good enough — Jason...
